title: One Empty Word Unlocked Ninety-Three Percent Yeses, Yet Raising the Cost Broke the Spell
description:
You think smart adults weigh every reason before saying yes! Yet one empty excuse unlocked nearly every busy New Yorker! This is the true story of the library copy machine study. Here is what went wrong with classic persuasion models.
